Get Active Matter now on Steam, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S: https://amplay.net/mrsaviorhd

I Played Active Matter, a new tactical extraction shooter that mixes intense PvP, horror, and time-bending mechanics into one terrifying experience.
The challenge was simple: jump into an online match, complete a mission, take out an enemy team, and safely extract back to my base.
Sounds easy, right?
Well… it definitely wasn't.
